title: Yad anicca (3)
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || 3 Rūpam bhikkhave anattā || yad anattā taṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti [page 023] XXII. 19. 6] ANICCAVAGGO DUTIYO 23 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || 4-5-6 Vedanā anattā || Sañña anattā || Saṅkhārā anattā || || 7 Viññāṇam anattā || yad anattā taṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 8 Evam passam bhikkhave || la || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
